27const SUBSET_TAG_LEN: usize = 6;
28pub(crate) const IDENTITY_H: &str = "Identity-H";
29pub(crate) const CMAP_NAME: Name = Name(b"Custom");
30pub(crate) const SYSTEM_INFO: SystemInfo = SystemInfo {
31    registry: Str(b"Adobe"),
32    ordering: Str(b"Identity"),
33    supplement: 0,
34};

36pub(crate) type Cid = u16;
37
38/// A shared function for CID fonts and Type3 fonts to write the cmap entries.
39pub(crate) fn write_cmap_entry<G>(
40    font: &Font,
41    entry: Option<&(String, Option<Location>)>,
42    sc: &mut SerializeContext,
43    cmap: &mut UnicodeCmap<G>,
44    g: G,
45) where
46    G: pdf_writer::types::GlyphId + Into<u32> + Copy,
47{
48    match entry {
49        None => sc.register_validation_error(ValidationError::NoCodepointMapping(
50            font.clone(),
51            GlyphId::new(g.into()),
52            None,
53        )),
54        Some((text, loc)) => {
55            let mut invalid_codepoint = text.is_empty();
56            let mut invalid_code = None;
57            let mut private_unicode = None;
58
59            for c in text.chars() {
60                if matches!(c as u32, 0x0 | 0xFEFF | 0xFFFE) {
61                    invalid_code = Some(c);
62                    invalid_codepoint = true;
63                }
64
65                if matches!(c as u32, 0xE000..=0xF8FF | 0xF0000..=0xFFFFD | 0x100000..=0x10FFFD) {
66                    private_unicode = Some(c);
67                }
68            }
69
70            match invalid_code {
71                Some(c) => sc.register_validation_error(ValidationError::InvalidCodepointMapping(
72                    font.clone(),
73                    GlyphId::new(g.into()),
74                    c,
75                    *loc,
76                )),
77                None if invalid_codepoint => sc.register_validation_error(
78                    ValidationError::NoCodepointMapping(font.clone(), GlyphId::new(g.into()), *loc),
79                ),
80                _ => {}
81            }
82
83            if let Some(code) = private_unicode {
84                sc.register_validation_error(ValidationError::UnicodePrivateArea(
85                    font.clone(),
86                    GlyphId::new(g.into()),
87                    code,
88                    *loc,
89                ));
90            }
91
92            if !text.is_empty() {
93                cmap.pair_with_multiple(g, text.chars());
94            }
95        }
96    }
97}

99/// A CID-keyed font.
100#[derive(Debug)]
101pub(crate) struct CIDFont {
102    /// The _actual_ underlying OTF font of the CID-keyed font.
103    font: Font,
104    /// A mapper that maps GIDs from the original font to CIDs, i.e. the corresponding GID in the font
105    /// subset. The subsetter will ensure that for CID-keyed CFF fonts, the CID-to-GID mapping
106    /// will be the identity mapping, regardless of what the mapping was in the original font. This
107    /// allows us to index both, CFF and glyf-based fonts, transparently using GIDs,
108    /// instead of having to distinguish according to the underlying font. See section
109    /// 9.7.4.2 for more information on how glyphs are indexed in a CID-keyed font.
110    glyph_remapper: GlyphRemapper,
111    /// A mapping from CIDs to their string in the original text.
112    cmap_entries: FxHashMap<u16, (String, Option<Location>)>,
113    /// The widths of the glyphs, _indexed by their CID_.
114    widths: Vec<f32>,
115    is_empty: bool,
116}
117
118impl CIDFont {
119    /// Create a new CID-keyed font.
120    pub(crate) fn new(font: Font) -> CIDFont {
121        // Always include the .notdef glyph. Will also always be included by the subsetter in
122        // the glyph remapper.
123        let widths = vec![font.advance_width(GlyphId::new(0)).unwrap_or(0.0)];
124
125        Self {
126            glyph_remapper: GlyphRemapper::new(),
127            cmap_entries: FxHashMap::default(),
128            widths,
129            font,
130            is_empty: true,
131        }
132    }
133
134    pub(crate) fn is_empty(&self) -> bool {
135        self.is_empty
136    }
137
138    pub(crate) fn font(&self) -> Font {
139        self.font.clone()
140    }
141
142    // Note that this refers to the units per em in PDF (which is always 1000), and not the
143    // units per em of the underlying font.
144    pub(crate) fn units_per_em(&self) -> f32 {
145        PDF_UNITS_PER_EM
146    }
147
148    #[inline]
149    pub(crate) fn get_cid(&self, glyph_id: GlyphId) -> Option<u16> {
150        self.glyph_remapper.get(glyph_id.to_u32() as u16)
151    }
152
153    /// Add a new glyph (if it has not already been added) and return its CID.
154    #[inline]
155    pub(crate) fn add_glyph(&mut self, glyph_id: GlyphId) -> Cid {
156        self.is_empty = false;
157
158        let new_id = self
159            .glyph_remapper
160            .remap(u16::try_from(glyph_id.to_u32()).unwrap());
161
162        // This means that the glyph ID has been newly assigned, and thus we need to add its width.
163        if new_id as usize >= self.widths.len() {
164            self.widths
165                .push(self.font.advance_width(glyph_id).unwrap_or(0.0));
166        }
167
168        new_id
169    }
170
171    #[inline]
172    pub(crate) fn get_codepoints(&self, cid: Cid) -> Option<&str> {
173        self.cmap_entries.get(&cid).map(|s| s.0.as_str())
174    }
175
176    #[inline]
177    pub(crate) fn set_codepoints(&mut self, cid: Cid, text: String, location: Option<Location>) {
178        self.cmap_entries.insert(cid, (text, location));
179    }
180
181    #[inline]
182    pub(crate) fn identifier(&self) -> FontIdentifier {
183        FontIdentifier::Cid(CIDIdentifier(self.font.clone()))
184    }
185
186    pub(crate) fn serialize(
187        &self,
188        sc: &mut SerializeContext,
189        root_ref: Ref,
190    ) -> KrillaResult<Chunk> {
191        let mut chunk = Chunk::new();
192
193        let cid_ref = sc.new_ref();
194        let descriptor_ref = sc.new_ref();
195        let cmap_ref = sc.new_ref();
196        let cid_set_ref = sc.new_ref();
197        let data_ref = sc.new_ref();
198
199        let glyph_remapper = &self.glyph_remapper;
200
201        let is_glyf = self.font.font_ref().glyf().is_ok();
202        let is_cff = self.font.font_ref().cff().is_ok();
203        let is_cff2 = self.font.font_ref().cff2().is_ok();
204
205        if !is_glyf && !is_cff && !is_cff2 {
206            return Err(KrillaError::Font(
207                self.font.clone(),
208                "font is missing an outline table".to_string(),
209            ));
210        }
211
212        // OS/2 fsType has a few bits that describe which kind of license the font has. Of
213        // particular interest is bit 2 "Restricted License embedding", which places restrictions on
214        // font embedding that are incompatible with some PDF standards.
215        //
216        // The OpenType spec intended for the different bits to be mutually exclusive. However, some
217        // fonts have multiple of the bits sets. The OpenType spec was thus adjusted to require
218        // mutual exclusion, allowing applications to assume the least-restrictive specified
219        // variant. Specifically, it also clarifies that "For Restricted License embedding to take
220        // effect, the Embedding permissions sub-field must have the value 2 (that is, only bit 1 is
221        // set)."
222        //
223        // Hence, we are not checking `fsType & 2 != 0` (as would be usual for bit flags),
224        // but rather `fsType & 0xF == 2`.
225        if self
226            .font
227            .font_ref()
228            .os2()
229            .is_ok_and(|os2| os2.fs_type() & 0xF == 2)
230        {
231            sc.register_validation_error(ValidationError::RestrictedLicense(self.font.clone()));
232        }
233
234        let (subsetted, global_bbox) = subset_font(self.font.clone(), glyph_remapper)?;
235        let num_glyphs = subsetted.num_glyphs();
236        let subsetted_data = subsetted.font_data().0;
237
238        let font_stream = {
239            let mut data = subsetted_data.as_ref().as_ref();
240
241            // If we have a CFF font, only embed the standalone CFF program.
242            let subsetted_ref = skrifa::FontRef::new(data).map_err(|_| {
243                KrillaError::Font(self.font.clone(), "failed to read font subset".to_string())
244            })?;
245
246            if let Some(cff) = subsetted_ref.data_for_tag(Cff::TAG) {
247                data = cff.as_bytes();
248            }
249
250            FilterStreamBuilder::new_from_binary_data(data).finish(&sc.serialize_settings())
251        };
252
253        let base_font = base_font_name(&self.font, &self.glyph_remapper);
254        let base_font_type0 = if is_cff {
255            format!("{base_font}-{IDENTITY_H}")
256        } else {
257            base_font.clone()
258        };
259
260        chunk
261            .type0_font(root_ref)
262            .base_font(Name(base_font_type0.as_bytes()))
263            .encoding_predefined(Name(IDENTITY_H.as_bytes()))
264            .descendant_font(cid_ref)
265            .to_unicode(cmap_ref);
266
267        let mut cid = chunk.cid_font(cid_ref);
268        cid.subtype(if is_cff {
269            CidFontType::Type0
270        } else {
271            CidFontType::Type2
272        });
273        cid.base_font(Name(base_font.as_bytes()));
274        cid.system_info(SYSTEM_INFO);
275        cid.font_descriptor(descriptor_ref);
276        cid.default_width(0.0);
277
278        if !is_cff {
279            cid.cid_to_gid_map_predefined(Name(b"Identity"));
280        }
281
282        // IN CID fonts, a upem value of 1000 is assumed for all fonts, so we need to convert.
283        let to_pdf_units = |v: f32| v / self.font.units_per_em() * self.units_per_em();
284
285        let mut first = 0;
286        let mut width_writer = cid.widths();
287        for (w, group) in self.widths.group_by_key(|&w| w) {
288            let end = first + group.len();
289            if w != 0.0 {
290                let last = end - 1;
291                width_writer.same(first as u16, last as u16, to_pdf_units(w));
292            }
293            first = end;
294        }
295
296        width_writer.finish();
297        cid.finish();
298
299        // The only reason we write this in the first place is that PDF/A-1b requires
300        // a CIDSet.
301        if !sc.serialize_settings().pdf_version().deprecates_cid_set() {
302            let cid_stream_data = {
303                // It's always guaranteed by the subsetter that CIDs start from 0 and are
304                // consecutive, so this encoding is very straight-forward.
305                let mut bytes = vec![];
306                bytes.extend([0xFFu8].repeat((num_glyphs / 8) as usize));
307                let padding = num_glyphs % 8;
308                if padding != 0 {
309                    bytes.push(!(0xFF >> padding))
310                }
311
312                bytes
313            };
314
315            let cid_stream = FilterStreamBuilder::new_from_binary_data(&cid_stream_data)
316                .finish(&sc.serialize_settings());
317            let mut cid_set = chunk.stream(cid_set_ref, cid_stream.encoded_data());
318            cid_stream.write_filters(cid_set.deref_mut());
319            cid_set.finish();
320            cid_stream.finish();
321        }
322
323        let mut flags = FontFlags::empty();
324        flags.set(
325            FontFlags::SERIF,
326            self.font
327                .postscript_name()
328                .is_some_and(|n| n.contains("Serif")),
329        );
330        flags.set(FontFlags::FIXED_PITCH, self.font.is_monospaced());
331        flags.set(FontFlags::ITALIC, self.font.italic_angle() != 0.0);
332        flags.insert(FontFlags::SYMBOLIC);
333        flags.insert(FontFlags::SMALL_CAP);
334
335        let bbox = {
336            Rect::from_ltrb(
337                to_pdf_units(global_bbox.left()),
338                to_pdf_units(global_bbox.top()),
339                to_pdf_units(global_bbox.right()),
340                to_pdf_units(global_bbox.bottom()),
341            )
342            .unwrap()
343        }
344        .to_pdf_rect();
345
346        let italic_angle = self.font.italic_angle();
347        let ascender = to_pdf_units(self.font.ascent());
348        let descender = to_pdf_units(self.font.descent());
349        let cap_height = self.font.cap_height().map(to_pdf_units).unwrap_or(ascender);
350        let stem_v = 10.0 + 0.244 * (self.font.weight() - 50.0);
351
352        let mut font_descriptor = chunk.font_descriptor(descriptor_ref);
353        font_descriptor
354            .name(Name(base_font.as_bytes()))
355            .flags(flags)
356            .bbox(bbox)
357            .italic_angle(italic_angle)
358            .ascent(ascender)
359            .descent(descender)
360            .cap_height(cap_height)
361            .stem_v(stem_v);
362
363        if !sc.serialize_settings().pdf_version().deprecates_cid_set() {
364            font_descriptor.cid_set(cid_set_ref);
365        }
366
367        if is_cff {
368            font_descriptor.font_file3(data_ref);
369        } else {
370            font_descriptor.font_file2(data_ref);
371        }
372
373        font_descriptor.finish();
374
375        let cmap = {
376            let mut cmap = UnicodeCmap::new(CMAP_NAME, SYSTEM_INFO);
377
378            // For the .notdef glyph, it's fine if no mapping exists, since it is included
379            // even if it was not referenced in the text.
380            for g in 1..self.glyph_remapper.num_gids() {
381                let entry = self.cmap_entries.get(&g);
382                write_cmap_entry(&self.font, entry, sc, &mut cmap, g);
383            }
384
385            cmap
386        };
387
388        let cmap_stream = cmap.finish();
389        let mut cmap = chunk.cmap(cmap_ref, &cmap_stream);
390        cmap.writing_mode(WMode::Horizontal);
391        cmap.finish();
392
393        let mut stream = chunk.stream(data_ref, font_stream.encoded_data());
394        font_stream.write_filters(stream.deref_mut());
395        if is_cff {
396            stream.pair(Name(b"Subtype"), Name(b"CIDFontType0C"));
397        }
398
399        stream.finish();
400
401        Ok(chunk)
402    }
403}

405/// Create a tag for a font subset.
406pub(crate) fn subset_tag<T: Hash>(data: &T) -> String {
407    const BASE: u128 = 26;
408    let mut hash = stable_hash128(data);
409    let mut letter = [b'A'; SUBSET_TAG_LEN];
410    for l in letter.iter_mut() {
411        *l = b'A' + (hash % BASE) as u8;
412        hash /= BASE;
413    }
414    std::str::from_utf8(&letter).unwrap().to_string()
415}
416
417pub(crate) fn base_font_name<T: Hash>(font: &Font, data: &T) -> String {
418    const REST_LEN: usize = SUBSET_TAG_LEN + 1 + 1 + IDENTITY_H.len();
419
420    let postscript_name = font.postscript_name().unwrap_or("unknown");
421    let max_len = 127 - REST_LEN;
422    let trimmed = &postscript_name[..postscript_name.len().min(max_len)];
423    let subset_tag = subset_tag(&data);
424
425    format!("{subset_tag}+{trimmed}")
426}

428#[cfg_attr(feature = "comemo", comemo::memoize)]
429fn subset_font(font: Font, glyph_remapper: &GlyphRemapper) -> KrillaResult<(Font, Rect)> {
430    let mut bbox: Option<Rect> = None;
431
432    let variation_coordinates = font
433        .variation_coordinates()
434        .iter()
435        .map(|v| (subsetter::Tag::new(v.0.get()), v.1.get()))
436        .collect::<Vec<_>>();
437    let font = subsetter::subset_with_variations(
438        font.font_data().as_ref(),
439        font.index(),
440        &variation_coordinates,
441        glyph_remapper,
442    )
443    .map_err(|e| KrillaError::Font(font.clone(), format!("failed to subset font: {e}")))
444    .and_then(|data| {
445        Font::new(Arc::new(data).into(), 0).ok_or(KrillaError::Font(
446            font.clone(),
447            "failed to subset font".to_string(),
448        ))
449    })?;
450    let global_bbox = font.bbox();
451
452    for g in 0..font.num_glyphs() {
453        if let Some(path_bbox) = compute_bbox(&font, skrifa::GlyphId::new(g)) {
454            bbox = bbox
455                .map(|mut r| {
456                    r.expand(&path_bbox);
457                    r
458                })
459                .or(Some(path_bbox));
460        }
461    }
462
463    Ok((font, bbox.unwrap_or(global_bbox)))
464}
465
466#[cfg_attr(feature = "comemo", comemo::memoize)]
467fn compute_bbox(font: &Font, glyph: skrifa::GlyphId) -> Option<Rect> {
468    let outline_glyphs = font.outline_glyphs();
469
470    if let Some(outline_glyph) = outline_glyphs.get(glyph) {
471        let mut glyph_builder = OutlineBuilder::new();
472        let _ = outline_glyph.draw(
473            DrawSettings::unhinted(Size::unscaled(), LocationRef::default()),
474            &mut glyph_builder,
475        );
476        glyph_builder.finish().map(|p| Rect::from_tsp(p.bounds()))
477    } else {
478        None
479    }
480}
